Save at least 10% when buying a pack vs buying singles on downlights – 10 pack code 338RE.

This LAP Ubertas Fixed Integrated LED Downlight provides versatile and efficient domestic lighting, featuring a clean white bezel. Electricians and homeowners can select from warm white (2700K), cool white (4000K), or daylight (6000K) colour temperatures to suit any ambience, alongside a dimmable function for adjustable light intensity. With an IP65 rating, it is ideal for bathroom zone 2 installations, offering reliable illumination in moisture-prone areas. Its robust design ensures a 30,000-hour lifespan and energy-efficient 4 kWh/1000h consumption, reducing maintenance and running costs. A high CRI 90 delivers accurate colour rendition for interiors.
